purpose: Third surface-authorship sensitivity pilot: keep the matched Dharma Connection leave-one-source-group-out evaluation from PR #67 while equalizing every retained train and held-out document to one deterministic 50-word window, so each author contributes exactly 200 training words per fold.

fold_training.joel_rule: one retained nonheldout Joel-only Dharma supplement plus the three nonheldout matched evaluation-thread Joel documents; omit only the two named training-only sources that failed the 50-word preflight before any model fit
fold_training.control_rule: four largest explicit-speaker non-overlap Dharma profile documents per control selected before normalization, using the same deterministic ranking rule as PR #67

short_training_exclusions.reason: First live 50-word preflight found this training-only Joel extraction has 13 whitespace-token words, so it cannot satisfy the precommitted 50-word window. It is not one of the ten held-out evaluation documents. Runtime must reverify that it remains under 50 words before exclusion.

Second live 50-word preflight found this training-only Joel supplement has 48 whitespace-token words, so it cannot satisfy the precommitted 50-word window. It is not one of the ten held-out evaluation documents. Runtime must reverify that it remains under 50 words before exclusion.

length_normalization.preflight_correction: Two feasibility-only runs stopped before model fitting: first on a 13-word training-only Joel row and then on a 48-word training-only Joel supplement. The 50-word window and all ten held-out evaluation documents remain unchanged. Rather than lower the window or inspect model outcomes, both infeasible non-test rows are explicitly removed and all classes are reduced to four training documents / 200 words per fold. Runtime revalidates both exclusions from live text and forbids exclusion of held-out rows.
length_normalization.reason: PR #67 balanced six documents per author but Joel supplied only about 776-1276 training words per fold versus 9525 for David Vardy and 12119 for Stian Gudmundsen Høiland. This corrected sensitivity removes text-mass asymmetry while preserving source-group separation, candidate authors, evaluation threads, and the original 50-word transform.

interpretation.comparison_target: Compare directly with the matched-platform whole-document result in state/IDIOLECT-SURFACE-SVM-MATCHED-PLATFORM-CV-RESULT-2026-08-18.json. If character-based Joel attribution remains poor after exact text-budget equalization, document-length/profile-mass imbalance is not sufficient to explain the weak surface signal and surface SVM should be deprioritized as the operational calibration target. If it improves materially, expand the length-normalized evaluation before drawing any idiolect conclusion.
interpretation.stop_rule: Do not repeatedly tune window size/position or swap training sources in response to model outcomes on these same ten held-out documents. The only post-preflight source changes are the explicitly documented removal of 13-word and 48-word training-only sources that could not satisfy the 50-word transform before any model fit.
